vocabulary.meaning_en: air going in and out of your body

vocabulary.example: She whispered the answer to me.
Their English is at a high level.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the same in size, amount or value
vocabulary.example: Men and women should get equal pay.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the movement of water; to move smoothly
vocabulary.example: The river flows into the sea.
She's very relaxed about the exam.

vocabulary.meaning_en: as good as it can be
to respect and like someone for what they do
vocabulary.example: I admire people who help others.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something good you did with effort
vocabulary.example: Finishing the marathon was a great achievement.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a possibility that something will happen
vocabulary.example: We have a good chance of winning.

vocabulary.meaning_en: losing something; (at a loss) not knowing what to do
hard work you use to do something
the quality of not giving up
a person or company you compete with
vocabulary.example: Our rival opened a shop next door.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a plan to win or succeed

fine_lines.title: Be in with a shout vs be at a loss
fine_lines.explanation_ar: be in with a shout تعني أن لديك فرصة جيدة للفوز أو النجاح. be at a loss تعني أنك لا تعرف ماذا تقول أو تفعل.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'Be in with a shout' = have a good chance of winning or succeeding. 'Be at a loss' = not know what to say or do.

examples.sentence: If we train hard, we're in with a shout of winning.
I was at a loss for words when I heard the news.

fine_lines.title: Hats off vs on point
fine_lines.explanation_ar: hats off (to someone) تُقال لتعبّر عن إعجابك بإنجاز شخص. on point تصف شيئاً ممتازاً ومثالياً تماماً (ملابس، تعليق، أداء).
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'Hats off to someone' praises a person's achievement. 'On point' describes something that is perfect or exactly right (clothes, a comment, a performance).

examples.sentence: Hats off to the team for finishing early!

expressions.meaning_en: very quietly, so others can't hear
expressions.example: He said something under his breath when the teacher gave more homework.

expressions.meaning_ar: يرتقي إلى مستوى أعلى / يساوي المستوى
expressions.meaning_en: to improve something, often to the same level as something similar
expressions.example: The company levelled up pay so that all staff earn the same.

expressions.meaning_en: to relax and accept what is happening or what others decide
expressions.example: I didn't plan the trip - I just went with the flow.
Your advice was on point - thank you.

expressions.meaning_en: said to show you admire someone's achievement
expressions.example: Hats off to the volunteers who cleaned the park!

expressions.phrase: be in with a shout (of something)
expressions.meaning_en: (UK, informal) to have a good chance of winning or succeeding
expressions.example: With these grades, you're in with a shout of getting into a good university.

expressions.meaning_ar: يكون حائراً / لا يعرف ماذا يفعل
expressions.meaning_en: to not know what to say or do
expressions.example: I'm at a loss - I don't know how to fix this printer.
The students are hard at it, preparing for their exams.

grammar.title: Prepositions in idioms: under, with, on, off, in, at
grammar.explanation_ar: كل تعبير له حرف جر ثابت لا نغيّره: under your breath، with the flow، on point، hats off، in with a shout، at a loss، hard at it. احفظ التعبير كاملاً.
grammar.explanation_en: Each idiom has a fixed preposition: under your breath, with the flow, on point, hats off, in with a shout, at a loss, hard at it. Learn the whole phrase.
examples: She said it under her breath.

questions.question: 'He said it under his breath' means he said it:

questions.question: I'm not choosing the restaurant - I'll just ___ .

questions.question: 'Your outfit is on point!' means it is:
___ to Sara for finishing the marathon!
questions.explanation_ar: hats off to someone = تحية تقدير لإنجازه.

questions.question: 'We're in with a shout' means:
questions.explanation_ar: be in with a shout = لدينا فرصة جيدة.

questions.question: I was ___ for words when I saw the surprise.
questions.explanation_ar: be at a loss (for words) = لا أعرف ماذا أقول.
questions.explanation_en: I didn't know what to say.

questions.question: Don't disturb Dad - he's ___ in the garden.

questions.question: Choose the correct preposition: 'Just go ___ the flow.'
questions.explanation_ar: التعبير الصحيح go with the flow.
questions.explanation_en: The idiom is 'go with the flow'.
